SectionObject.Title: Housing density
SectionObject.Text1: Where do most people live in Norrköping? The model has taken into account the city's barriers and calculated how many residents you reach within 250 meters of each point. The analysis can be used to more accurately calculate data when, for example, planning public transport and school places.

SectionObject.Title: Workplace density
SectionObject.Text1: Here you can see where there are most workplaces in Norrköping today. As you can see, it is in central Norrköping and at Vrinnevisjukhuset that there is the densest number of workplaces. But if we look ahead to 2050, we can see that the party workplaces can be found in Butängen, on Sylten and in Norra Himmelstalund.

SectionObject.Title: Lighting
SectionObject.Text1:
Did you know that there are around 28,000 lighting poles in the municipality of Norrköping?
In the municipality, all lighting poles are documented in a map. In order to update the map, the municipality sometimes needs to go out to measure where poles are or use drawings for new construction. With the help of the new AI technology developed within the SimStad project, an AI (artificial intelligence) can itself scan an area and classify different types of objects, which both makes the information more detailed and significantly easier to keep up to date.
On the model you can see where there are lighting poles and how large an area the light covers. For the municipality, this is important in order to be able to analyze where new lighting is needed in future planning and to be able to look after the existing lighting.
